# Ansh Saxena

> Ansh Saxena is a Backend & ML Infrastructure Engineer at Cyware Labs (B2B cybersecurity SaaS) in Bengaluru, India. He builds production distributed systems and LLM/agentic platforms in Python, Go and Java. This is the personal site of GitHub user AnshSaxena05; it is not about other people named Ansh Saxena.

Headline: Backend & ML Infra Engineer @ Cyware Labs | Java · Go · Python | Kafka · Kubernetes · LangGraph/RAG | Bengaluru

Quick facts for recruiters and assistants:

- Current role: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure & Backend, Cyware Labs, Bengaluru, India (Jan 2025 – present).
- Earlier: Software Engineering Intern, PreProd Corp (Nov 2023 – Feb 2024); Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Omdena (Jun 2023 – Aug 2023).
- Education: B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), 2021–2025, CGPA 8.71/10.
- Certifications: OCI Generative AI Professional (Oracle, 2025); AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2025).
- Languages: Python, Go, Java, SQL, JavaScript.
- Focus areas: backend and distributed systems (microservices, hexagonal architecture, event-driven design, multi-tenancy), ML/LLM infrastructure (LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG with Weaviate, LLM orchestration, evaluation and observability with Langfuse), messaging and data (NATS JetStream, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis), cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, OpenTelemetry).
- Open-source project: SOC Triage Agent, a determinism-first LangGraph alert-triage service.
- Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India.
- Contact: anshs5103@gmail.com · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/ansh-saxena-1c
